shopee_policy: Returns and refunds follow Shopee's Return/Refund policy. Buyers ask for them in the Shopee app (My Purchases → the order → Return/Refund), and Shopee decides if there's a dispute.
Shopee Guarantee: Shopee holds the buyer's payment until they confirm the order arrived OK, so a buyer is always protected against wrong, damaged, missing or not-as-described items.
Cancellations follow Shopee's rules. The shop never asks a buyer to cancel.
Payments, refunds, vouchers and discounts only happen inside Shopee, never by bank transfer or another app.
Singapore: shops may not set their own return terms or charge extra for returns (Shopee can give penalty points). Malaysia: a return that's the shop's fault costs the shop both ways' shipping.
The shop's own extra policies can add to these, never take anything away.
notes: The shop's promises to buyers. Chat replies may only promise what is written here. shopee_policy is Shopee's own policy: it always applies, can't be switched off, and Claude puts it back if it goes missing. my_extra_policies are the owner's own extras on top, e.g. {"policy": "1-year warranty", "details": "Brand handles it"}.
